name: Nano Processor
blurb: Progressive FPGA soft-processor in VHDL, iterating from a 4-bit to an 8-bit architecture with Xilinx primitive-level optimisation, deployed on a Basys 3 board.
detail:
Implemented the full datapath and control path from scratch: a register file with multiplexed read ports, a ripple-carry ALU, a program counter with jump and branch logic, instruction ROM, instruction decoder and a hardwired control unit, then extended the ISA beyond the base specification with additional arithmetic and bitwise operations.

Verified through waveform simulation against hand-computed expected values and deployed to a Basys 3 board with seven-segment and LED output for live instruction tracing.
